gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu reads tall and modern, its terminals held well away from the stroke. Megrim's strokes all finish at one measured thickness, so against that towering body the pair has a crisp, futuristic edge no other combination here shares.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham looks bold for its size, since its lowercase stands so tall. Megrim glides on strokes that never change weight, while the body font wins on gaps in the e that keep each word easy to scan.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Clean and contemporary, Noto Sans Ol Chiki keeps curve tails tucked back so words form solid blocks. Megrim has none of a brush's pressure-swelling, and its angular, futuristic lines earn their place when set big and brief.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Noto Sans Old Hungarian is friendly and open, even at tiny sizes. Megrim is best at drawing a single-width line through every glyph, while the body font does its best work keeping tall a, e and s wide and legible.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Megrim's strokes look like thin plastic tubing bent into loops, every ending cut at one measured thickness, angular and futuristic. Noto Sans Old Italic sits beside it, compact and professional, with curve endings held apart.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-north-arabia: Megrim draws its angular, futuristic letters with the constant weight of a stencil-cut channel, and its c opens like a bent paperclip. Noto Sans Old North Arabian then fills in dense, tall lowercase, with terminals pointing outward.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Noto Sans Old Permic reads friendly, its rounded forms staying open to the side. Megrim's true monoline drawing gives the top its futuristic angles, while the body's lowercase, nearly as tall as the capitals, grounds everything underneath.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Drawn as if with a ruler and compass, Megrim keeps every line angular and futuristic. It excels at that precise display work, whereas Noto Sans Old Persian does its job through open counters and a lofty lowercase that breathe into the white space.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Megrim runs a single track width like a neon sign tube, angular and futuristic. Noto Sans Old Sogdian answers with a tall x-height nearly reaching cap height, and wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk, which is this pair's strongest quality.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Megrim brings straight-edged, constant strokes with an angular, futuristic bite. It earns its keep when set big and brief, while Noto Sans Old Turkic adds chunky, tall lowercase with open-mouthed curves.
